sloka: स वानरसहस्राणां कोटीभिरभिसंवृतः ।क्षिप्रमेष्यति वैदेहि राक्षसानां निबर्हणः ।। ५.३९.३४।।।।
transliteration: sa vānarasahasrāṇāṁ koṭībhirabhisaṁvṛtaḥ ।kṣiprameṣyati vaidehi rākṣasānāṁ nibarhaṇaḥ ।। 5.39.34।।।।

translations.english: "O Vaidehi Sugriva will reach this place with thousands of crores of vanaras very soon and would kill all the ogres.
